```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(MuMIn)

# --- STEP 1: Rename and clean the ID column in the ED dataframe ---
ed_cleaned <- ed %>%
  dplyr::rename(SampleID_clean = PhPh_Genotype) %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = tolower(trimws(SampleID_clean)))
 


# --- STEP 2: Clean the ID column in your cluster data and merge ---
cluster_summary_clean <- cluster_summary %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = tolower(trimws(SampleID_clean)))

# Merge them together safely
ed_with_clusters <- ed_cleaned %>%
  inner_join(cluster_summary_clean, by = "SampleID_clean")


# --- STEP 3: Run the Linear Mixed-Effects Models (Control for site/run) ---
# Testing K_3
model_k3 <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_3 + (1 | site), data = ed_with_clusters)
print("--- K_3 Model Analysis ---")
Anova(model_k3, type = "II")

# Testing K_4
model_k4 <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_4 + (1 | site), data = ed_with_clusters)
print("--- K_4 Model Analysis ---")
Anova(model_k4, type = "II")

# Testing K_5
model_k5 <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_5 + (1 | site), data = ed_with_clusters)
print("--- K_5 Model Analysis ---")
Anova(model_k5, type = "II")


# --- STEP 4: Compare Model Explanatory Power ---
print("--- AIC Comparison (Lower is Better) ---")
print(AIC(model_k3, model_k4, model_k5))

print("--- R-Squared Performance (Look at Marginal R2m for Fixed Effects) ---")
print("K3 R2:")
print(r.squaredGLMM(model_k3))
print("K4 R2:")
print(r.squaredGLMM(model_k4))
print("K5 R2:")
print(r.squaredGLMM(model_k5))
```
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(MuMIn)

# --- 1. Run the Mixed Model ---
# We model ED50 as a function of NPQ, keeping site/run as a random effect
model_npq <- lmer(ED50 ~ NPQ + (1 | site), data = ed_with_physiology)

# --- 2. Check Significance ---
print("--- NPQ Significance Test ---")
Anova(model_npq, type = "II")

# --- 3. Check Explanatory Power (R-squared) ---
print("--- NPQ R-Squared ---")
r.squaredGLMM(model_npq)
```
